{% endcomment %}# {{ product_name }}

> {{ product_name }} is a free website health check-up for business owners. Enter a website address and, in about a minute, get a plain-language report that scores five vital signs, explains the biggest risks to the business and gives a treatment plan with quick wins first, as a web page and a PDF.

{{ product_name }} is run by {{ branding.legal.operator }}, {{ branding.title }}. It is free and needs no account. A check-up reads up to {{ max_pages }} public pages of a website, the way a visitor would, and uses Google PageSpeed Insights to measure speed. Each visitor can start up to {{ rate_limit }} check-ups an hour.

The five vital signs:
{% for sign in vital_signs %}
- {{ sign.title }}: {{ sign.text }}{% endfor %}

Reports live at private, unguessable links under /checkups/. They are not public pages: please don't index, quote or summarise them.

## Main pages

- [Start a free check-up]({{ base_url }}{% url 'core:home' %}): The homepage, with the check-up form and an explanation of what is examined and how it works.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy]({{ base_url }}{% url 'core:privacy' %}): What is collected (the website address, an optional name and email, a scrambled IP), why, and how to ask for deletion.
- [Terms of service]({{ base_url }}{% url 'core:terms' %}): The rules for using the free check-up, governed by the laws of {{ branding.legal.country }}.
- [Cookie policy]({{ base_url }}{% url 'core:cookies' %}): The one security cookie and the browser storage the site uses. No analytics or advertising.
- [Acceptable use policy]({{ base_url }}{% url 'core:acceptable_use' %}): Only check websites you own or may check; how {{ product_name }} visits websites.
- [Disclaimer]({{ base_url }}{% url 'core:disclaimer' %}): Scores are automated estimates, not a security audit or proof of legal compliance.
